provenance: Original fictional bilingual content resource; all index cards and relevance labels authored before baseline execution
scope: Rank the five supplied index_text cards; bodies and version metadata are returned as evidence but not used for lexical scoring. Locale variants are parallel collections, not a translation or multilingual retrieval system.
tokenizer: ka-lex-v1: search-key-v1; English ASCII letter runs or decimal digit runs; Chinese longest known surface at each position, ASCII runs/digits, otherwise one code point; punctuation and whitespace skipped
ranking: round cosine scores to 12 decimal places for ranking only; descending score, then frozen candidate order; top score <= 0 means abstain
tf: raw count in the index card or query
idf: ln((D+1)/(df+1))+1; fit on document cards only; absent query terms ignored in lexical vectors
success: top prediction belongs to relevant set; for an empty relevant set, success requires abstention; denominator is all 9 queries

failure_taxonomy.stale_version: surface overlap favors a superseded source for a current query
failure_taxonomy.common_term_distraction: frequent geographic term outweighs a discriminating status term
failure_taxonomy.synonym_gap: different spellings have no vocabulary overlap
failure_taxonomy.representation_collision: distinct documents have the same direction under a representation
failure_taxonomy.out_of_scope: answering with a document when none is relevant
